line.en: about four kilometres of illuminations, free and no booking. the lights come on around 17:00; start at hanshin-mae in the north and walk south to namba nishiguchi.
line.de: etwa vier kilometer beleuchtung, kostenlos und ohne anmeldung. die lichter gehen gegen 17:00 an; im norden bei hanshin-mae starten und nach süden bis namba nishiguchi laufen.
line.tr: yaklaşık dört kilometre aydınlatma, ücretsiz ve rezervasyonsuz. ışıklar 17:00 civarında yanıyor; kuzeyde hanshin-mae'den başla, güneye namba nishiguchi'ye yürü.

sparks.why: Midosuji Illumination 2026, 3 Nov to 31 Dec, about 4 km from Hanshin-mae to Namba Nishiguchi from about 17:00, per japantravel.com and todolist-japan.com; the official Osaka site was not checked for exact hours.
